voiceMarkers.detail: Remembered by Jaina: says everything kindly; would have told her to come home through the pebble 'kindly'; 'wait for the light' is his advice, and he would have been right.

howOthersAddressHim.speaker: Jaina (ch2, aloud)
howOthersAddressHim.pattern: 'my master... Archmage Antonidas' to Sylvanas; plain 'Antonidas' in her thoughts.

referencedFacts.detail: Archmage of the Kirin Tor/Dalaran; Jaina's master; brings her to council and favours her (per the Farstrider file).
Sylvanas is angry at him and wonders whether he sent Jaina or even knows where she is.

Jaina left a note on his desk; he reads everything on it eventually, between three other things, a cup gone cold at his elbow. His twin to Jaina's rune pebble sits in his study. He is 'always too slow, until it turned out he'd been right to be slow'. He drilled Jaina to clear her head and listen again over cold benches.
Does not know where she is; Jaina has kept her pebble wrapped and quiet since Dalaran so he could not call her home.

arc.currentPosition: Off-page; will find the note. Whether he reaches for the pebble is open.
